description: 한국철도공사_연도별 수송실적 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 이 데이터는 한국철도공사가 매년 발행하는 철도통계연보에서 수집한 ‘연도별 수송실적’으로, 각 해별로 일반열차(예: KTX, 새마을, 무궁화, 통근열차 등)의 여객 수송 실적을 열차종. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are 연도별 여객 수송실적, 열차종별 수송 인원, 수송 추이 분석, 노선별 이용 패턴, 사회경제적 영향. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
